exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "While Doing (Two Actions at the Same Time)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ながら (〜nagara) matches "While Doing (Two Actions at the Same Time)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ながら (〜nagara).
exercises.explanation: While doing; expresses two actions happening at the same time.
